player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nǔ e è na lɛ́ wá ɔ́ ɖó ná nyí [macro micro] bó nɔ́ zán nùɖé 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Wemɛ lɛ ɖokpo ɖokpo ɖó na ɖo 0 kpo 8 kpo tɛntin.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row, alǒ col ɔ ɖò mɛ ǎ.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Azɔ̀tɔ́ ɔ ɖó na xò ɖò micro board e bɔ d'é jí é mɛ.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: The micro board is already won.

game_action.played: Player {player_id} wɔ dɔ le mikɔ bɔdɔ {macro_idx}, sɛlɛ {micro_idx} (lɛta {row}, kɔlɔm {col}). Player {opponent_id} gbɔ na ɖe blɛ wɔ {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: {player_id} ɔ ɖu Final Tic Tac Toe! jí.
